title: British Midland Virtual Website Now Live
summary: The official British Midland Virtual website is now live.
content: We're delighted to officially launch the British Midland Virtual website.

After months of planning and development, the new website brings together everything pilots need to discover British Midland Virtual, explore our growing fleet, view our expanding network and stay up to date with the latest news from across the airline.

Designed around the heritage of British Midland, the website combines a modern experience with classic airline styling. From fleet information and interactive route maps to future operational resources, this marks the beginning of an exciting new chapter for the airline.

Although today's launch represents an important milestone, development is far from complete. We will continue expanding the website with our Operations Centre, pilot resources, comprehensive documentation and additional community features.
As our network continues to grow from Birmingham, we look forward to welcoming new pilots who share our passion for realistic airline operations and the history of British Midland.
We would like to thank everyone who has supported the project throughout development. Your enthusiasm and feedback have helped shape the airline we are proud to build today.
author: British Midland Crew Services

title: Now Welcoming New & Type-Rated Airbus Pilots
summary: Whether you're taking your first steps into virtual aviation or already experienced on the Airbus family, British Midland Virtual welcomes you to join our growing community.
content: British Midland Virtual is proud to welcome both new and experienced Airbus pilots to our growing community.

Whether you're flying your very first virtual airline route or already have experience operating the Airbus A320 family, you'll find a friendly and supportive environment built around realistic operations and an appreciation of British Midland's heritage.
Our current fleet provides a range of Airbus aircraft for short-haul European and long-haul international services from our Birmingham hub.

We believe realistic flying should be enjoyable and accessible, with no unnecessary barriers to getting started. New pilots can learn as they fly, while experienced crews can immediately enjoy our routes and procedures.
As our network and community continue to grow, we invite anyone with a passion for virtual aviation to become part of British Midland Virtual and help write the next chapter of our story.
If you're looking for a welcoming virtual airline inspired by one of Britain's most recognisable carriers, we'd be delighted to have you on board.
author: British Midland Crew Services

title: Airbus A319, A320 & A321 Fleet Ready for Operations
summary: British Midland Virtual's launch Airbus fleet is fully configured and ready for operations, with further aircraft planned for future expansion.
content: Following extensive work behind the scenes, the British Midland Virtual Airbus A319, A320 and A321 fleet is now fully prepared for operations.

Our initial fleet consists of three Airbus aircraft, each configured to provide a consistent and immersive experience for our pilots. Leading the fleet are Airbus A319 G-BMFI 'City of Lichfield', Airbus A320 G-BMFB 'City of Coventry' and Airbus A321 G-BMFA 'City of Birmingham'.
Every aircraft features a custom livery inspired by the final British Midland colour scheme, reimagined for today's virtual skies.
Together, the Airbus A319, A320 and A321 form the backbone of our European operation from Birmingham Airport, with each aircraft assigned to routes suited to its capacity and operational profile.
Further aircraft are planned as British Midland continues to expand its fleet and strengthen its network across Europe and beyond.
As the fleet grows, we will continue celebrating the cities, towns and regions that define the Heart of Britain.
author: Fleet Management

title: British Midland Virtual Joins the SayIntentions.AI Virtual Airline Programme
summary: British Midland Virtual is now officially part of the SayIntentions.AI Virtual Airline Programme, bringing an even more immersive flying experience to our pilots.
content: We're delighted to announce that British Midland Virtual has officially joined the SayIntentions.AI Virtual Airline Programme.

This partnership allows our pilots to enhance every flight with realistic AI Air Traffic Control, intelligent cabin crew, AI dispatch services and seamless virtual airline integration through SayIntentions.AI.
Pilots can link British Midland Virtual through their SayIntentions Pilot Portal by selecting British Midland Virtual within the Virtual Airline settings.

Thinking of subscribing to SayIntentions.AI? Speak to a member of the British Midland staff team before purchasing. We have an exclusive 10% discount code available for British Midland Virtual pilots.
This partnership represents another step towards building a professional, immersive and realistic virtual airline experience inspired by British Midland's heritage.
author: British Midland Crew Services

title: British Midland Virtual Announces Partnership with BATC
summary: British Midland Virtual is pleased to announce a new partnership with BeyondATC, strengthening our commitment to professional and immersive virtual airline operations.
content: We're delighted to announce that British Midland Virtual has entered into a partnership with BeyondATC, bringing another powerful tool to our pilots as we continue developing a more immersive and realistic virtual airline experience.
BeyondATC provides AI-powered air traffic control and live traffic for Microsoft Flight Simulator, creating a more dynamic and realistic environment for pilots during their flights.

Our partnership will allow British Midland Virtual to build a closer connection between our airline operations and the tools our pilots use, helping provide a more authentic British Midland experience when flying our network.
As our route network and fleet continue to expand, integrating British Midland more closely with the tools our pilots use will become increasingly important.
We're excited to work alongside the BeyondATC team and look forward to developing our integration further as British Midland Virtual continues to grow.
author: British Midland Crew Services

title: British Midland Agrees Lease for Airbus A330-900
summary: British Midland Virtual has agreed a lease for an Airbus A330-900 through SMBC Capital, marking another step in the development of our long-haul fleet.
content: British Midland Virtual is pleased to announce that a lease agreement has been secured for an Airbus A330-900 through SMBC Capital.
The aircraft will be introduced to the British Midland Virtual fleet using the Headwind A330-900, marking another significant step in our long-haul fleet development.
The A330-900 will provide British Midland with a modern widebody platform capable of supporting longer-range operations as the airline continues to expand beyond its European network.
The agreement further strengthens our long-haul ambitions and follows continued investment in the development of our fleet and network from Birmingham.
The aircraft will form part of the next generation of British Midland long-haul operations, with its eventual routes and entry into service details to be announced separately.
author: British Midland Crew Services

title: Introducing British Midland Group
summary: British Midland is becoming part of a wider aviation group, bringing our passenger, regional and cargo operations together under one organisation.
content: British Midland Virtual is entering a new chapter with the formation of British Midland Group.

The new structure brings together our aviation businesses under one organisation, creating a stronger foundation for continued growth while allowing each business to develop its own identity and operational role.
The Group brings together British Midland Ltd, British Midland Regional Ltd and European Cargo as distinct aviation businesses operating under a shared organisation.
This structure allows us to share technology, expertise, infrastructure and operational resources across the Group while continuing to develop each business independently.

The reorganisation also creates opportunities beyond our own airlines. British Midland Group is being developed with the capability to support other virtual airlines through the technology, skills and operational systems we have built.
For our pilots, the Group creates the opportunity to fly across participating airlines while retaining familiar processes, systems and standards.
British Midland Group represents our ambition to build something larger than a single virtual airline: a connected aviation organisation built around the Heart of Britain.
author: British Midland Group

title: European Cargo Joins British Midland Group
summary: European Cargo has joined British Midland Group, expanding the organisation into dedicated cargo operations.
content: British Midland Group is pleased to announce that European Cargo has joined the Group.
The addition of European Cargo expands British Midland Group beyond passenger aviation and introduces a dedicated cargo operation to our growing aviation portfolio.

European Cargo will operate as a distinct business within the Group, allowing it to develop its own cargo identity and operations while benefiting from the wider technology, expertise and infrastructure available across British Midland Group.
The move forms part of our wider strategy to build a diverse aviation organisation capable of supporting different types of virtual airline operations.
European Cargo joins British Midland Ltd and British Midland Regional Ltd as one of three aviation businesses within British Midland Group.
Further details regarding European Cargo's fleet, network and future development will be announced as the operation continues to take shape.
author: British Midland Group

title: British Midland ACARS Operational in Alpha
summary: Our custom ACARS platform has entered its operational Alpha phase, providing the foundation for British Midland's next generation of flight operations.
content: British Midland Virtual is pleased to announce that our custom ACARS platform is now operational in Alpha.
Developed specifically for British Midland, the system is designed to provide a dedicated operational platform connecting pilots, flights and the wider airline infrastructure.
The Alpha release introduces the foundations of our flight tracking and operational systems, with continued development taking place alongside live use by our pilots.
ACARS will form a central part of the British Midland experience, supporting flight operations while providing the foundations for future operational tools and services.

As development continues, the system will evolve through testing, feedback and additional features. The Alpha phase allows us to develop the platform around the real requirements of British Midland operations rather than relying on a generic virtual airline system.
This is an important milestone in the development of British Midland Virtual and represents another step towards creating a fully connected airline operation.
author: British Midland Development

title: Pioneer Class Launches with the Airbus A350
summary: British Midland Virtual launches Pioneer Class, introducing the Airbus A350 as a new generation of long-haul flying.
content: British Midland Virtual is proud to announce the launch of Pioneer Class, introducing the Airbus A350 to our growing fleet.
Pioneer Class represents the next generation of British Midland long-haul flying, built around the Airbus A350-1000 and designed to expand our capabilities beyond the European network.
The A350 brings a modern widebody aircraft into the British Midland fleet and provides a new platform for long-haul operations from our Birmingham hub.
The introduction of Pioneer Class forms part of our wider fleet development strategy, complementing our existing Airbus narrowbody fleet while establishing a dedicated long-haul identity.
The aircraft will open new opportunities for international operations and allow British Midland to connect Birmingham with destinations further afield.
Pioneer Class marks an important milestone in the continued evolution of British Midland Virtual and begins a new chapter for our long-haul operation.
author: British Midland Fleet Management

title: Foundry Class — The Next Generation of Regional Flying
summary: British Midland Virtual prepares to introduce Foundry Class, bringing the Fokker 100 and ATR 72 into the Group's regional operation.
content: A new chapter of regional flying is taking shape within British Midland Group with the development of Foundry Class.
Foundry Class will introduce two aircraft types to the regional operation: the Fokker 100 and ATR 72.

The aircraft will provide additional flexibility for regional and short-haul flying, complementing the wider Group fleet and allowing operations to be tailored to routes where frequency, capacity and regional connectivity are key.
The Fokker 100 and ATR 72 will form an important part of the regional aviation strategy, providing new opportunities for British Midland Regional Ltd as the operation develops.
Further details regarding aircraft allocations, routes and entry into service will be announced ahead of the public launch.
Foundry Class represents another step in the development of a diverse aviation organisation capable of operating across mainline, regional and cargo markets.
author: British Midland Fleet Management
